blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Talisay police have formed a task force to focus on thefts involving water meters in the city. This was after they recorded 30 cases of theft of water meters in different areas of the city just this September. And the arrest last Sunday, September 27, of a man who was caught on security camera stealing a water meter in Sitio Uldog, Barangay Cansojong, Talisay City.
